statement: let Q (n : ℕ) := (Nat.log 2 (n + 2)) ^ 2; let arcs (n : ℕ) := {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ Q n ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t - (a : ℝ) / q| ≤ (Q n : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * n)}; ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), 1 ≤ Q n → Q n ≤ n → t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → t ∉ arcs n → ∃ q a : ℕ, Q n < q ∧ q ≤ n / Q n ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t - (a : ℝ) / q| ≤ 1 / ((q : ℝ) * (((n / Q n : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1))

plain_statement.en: Each point in [0,1] outside the Goldbach major arcs has a reduced approximation a/q with Q < q ≤ H and error at most 1/(q(H+1)), where H = ⌊n/Q⌋.
plain_statement.zh: 令 H = ⌊n/Q⌋。区间 [0,1] 内的每个次弧点都有既约逼近 a/q，满足 Q < q ≤ H、0 ≤ a ≤ q，且误差至多为 1/(q(H+1))。

brief.en: Use Dirichlet’s theorem of order H. The inequality n < Q(H+1) puts any candidate with q ≤ Q inside the posted major arc of radius Q/(qn).
brief.zh: 应用 H 阶狄利克雷逼近定理。由 n < Q(H+1)，若候选分母 q ≤ Q，则该点必落入目录定义的半径为 Q/(qn) 的主弧。
